product_metadata.title: Battilo Burnt Orange Throw Blanket 51" x 67" Warm Fall Throw Blanket for Couch, Halloween Decoration, Woven Chenille Knit Throw Blanket, Super Soft, Cozy, Autumn Fall Decor Throw Blanket Orange.
features: LUXURIOUSLY SOFT: Get cozy with this knit throw blanket that is beautiful and smooth to touch. Soft and cozy texture made of 100% chenille yarn.
ELEGANT AND VERSATILE: Perfect for snuggling and keeping you warm or adding color and accent to your living space. It is soft, breathable and lightweight for all season use.

MIX AND MATCH: The cozy chenille throw blanket provides the perfect accent for your couch, sofa, bed, and living space; Mix it up with your decor, drape it over your couch, sofa, sectional or bed to add style to your room.
DIVERSE USAGE: Couch throw, bed blanket, outdoor indoor use blanket, travel, gift item, house decor, holiday birthday housewarming anniversary gift throw, photo prop and more
EASY TO CARE: Machine wash with cold water separately on gentle/delicate cycle. Do Not Bleach. Do Not Iron. Tumble Dry No Heat.
